raw_response:
My land is 9.5 mu all together. I have been working it for 30 years so I know what it can do. My husband and I are the only two at home, and some of our young ones work outside now, so I cannot count on help except at the busiest time when I pay a neighbor or a small harvester to come through.

I split my ground this way: about 4 mu I keep in cotton, because cotton is what our village has always grown and I know the pests and the timing. The other 5.5 mu I plant winter wheat in October, then as soon as the wheat is cut in early June I put summer maize straight into the stubble. Two harvests off one field — that is how we make the land pay on the plain here.

For cotton I buy the Bt seed from the county dealer, the kind that resists the bollworm. Last year 国欣 variety did well for my neighbor so I will use the same. I put on about 50 jin (25 kg) of 15-15-15 compound at planting and then topdress 40 jin of urea (about 20 kg) when the buds come on — I know if I skimp on fertilizer the bolls drop and I lose money, better to spend the fertilizer money than risk the harvest. I water from the well maybe three times — before sowing, at flowering, and during the boll-filling if the heat is bad. Cotton is a lot of spraying — aphids, spider mites, and the bollworm still comes even with Bt seed, so I plan on 5 or 6 sprays through the summer. I plough before planting because the ground gets crusty. A good year I get 250 jin (125 kg) of lint but I count in seed cotton — about 250 kg of seed cotton per mu is what I hope for.

For the wheat, I use 济麦 improved seed same as most of my neighbors. Base fertilizer is one bag DAP (50 kg) with some potash mixed in, then I topdress urea at green-up in March, about 30 jin. I water at winter, at green-up, and at filling — three times, four if spring is dry. I spray twice, once for aphids and once for the "three diseases" mix at heading. After maize in autumn I rotary till and plant. I expect around 450 kg per mu, sometimes 500 in a good year.

The maize goes in right after wheat with no tilling — I just drill it into the stubble to save time and save on the tractor fee. I plant hybrid 郑单958 or 先玉335, whatever the dealer has. Fertilizer I put down with the seed, about one bag of compound, then topdress urea at the big trumpet stage. Two sprays, mostly for corn borer. Two waterings if the summer rain is short. 500 kg per mu is what I count on.
